name: Aluar Aluminio Argentino S.A.I.C.
summary: Aluar Aluminio Argentino S.A.I.C. engages in the production and sale of aluminum products in Argentina and internationally. It operates in four segments: Primary Division; Processed Foods Division; Power Generation; and Engineering, Industrial Construction and Assembly, and Others. The company offers ingots, bars, wire rods, and plates; value-added products, including profiles, bars, tubes, thick laminates, and foils; and zincalum. It also supplies energy; and markets energy from the wind farm. Aluar Aluminio Argentino S.A.I.C. was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
